notes.title: 11.16 Update
notes.notes:
-the mas FPS is now limited
-fixed the bug that some achievements cannot be achieved
-fixed the bug that some objects do not have floatage
-fixed the bug that the boxes will influence the floatage
-fixed the bug that the player will lose at the edge of some map

notes.title: 【November 16, 2021】we have updated the English language version
notes.notes:
We have updated the English language version of physics world. After entering the game, you can select the third button "setting" and change the “language” to English to play the English version of physical world.Enjoy it！
